title: He Cut Down a Cadet in Front of Everyone . . . Then Said Call the Doctors (Part 4)
credit: Swordmaster's Youngest Son (Hwangze Penguin / Mr. Big / AZI)

segments.say: Their job is to find a missing heir named Sember *Bill*. But the order came from Jin's own father, and Jin smells a *rat*.
Then a scout screams that Group Two has been *attacked*. Jin sprints ahead and finds *blood* all over the snow.
Group Two is gone, Mesa is *missing*, and the footprints say there was only one *attacker*. One guy. Ouch.
Jin spots the enemy and tells Vellop to close his *eyes*. In two seconds, hit the one on the *left*.
Steel flashes in the dark, and a Kinzelo scout drops into the *snow*.
Jin pins the scout and gives him two *choices*. Talk and live, or stay quiet and watch everyone you love *die*.
Jin swears on his clan's honor to keep him safe, and the guy starts *singing* like a canary.
The Kinzelo are terrorists who want to *crown* their own king of the world. Real modest bunch.
Their base sits on Halfmen land with twenty four-star fighters, and they grabbed Mesa for *propaganda*.
So Jin says he is going in *alone*. Scott loses it. Twenty enemies, one cadet. Jin tells them to patch up and wait.
Jin does not budge. He is the strongest cadet left, and everybody knows it. Main-character *energy*.
Twenty four-star fighters against one three-star blade. Brave, or *stupid*. Jin does not care. He wants *Mesa* back.
So he throws a net of wind over the forest, and the enemy's trail *lights* up.
He sprints across the plains and drops in sword *first*. They never saw it coming.
A mage screams, how can a Runcandel cast *magic*? Fire lashes out, and he freezes it *cold*.
The mage's flames fizzle, and Jin cuts him *down*. Wrong kid to pick a fight with.
Turns out the enemy did not even hide their tracks. They think cadets are *weak*.
So Jin does what any sane person would do. He sets their camp on *fire*.
Panic. Water, get more water! Nobody has a clue who *started* it.
While the camp runs around like headless chickens, Jin swipes the keys and slips *inside*.
Down a trapdoor, he finds Mesa, tied up and shaking. Jin cuts her *free*.
Then the ceiling shakes. Something *huge* is coming.
Mesa begs him to leave her behind if things get *dire*. Jin says not another *word*.
They climb the stairs together, and at the top stands a shadow with claws. A *Halfman*.
A giant white werewolf smashes Mesa aside with one *blow*.
He sneers at the cadets who cannot even put out a fire. Jin answers, I am the son of Ciaron *Runcandel*.
The werewolf laughs. A Runcandel! You will be my most prized *prey*. Big talk for a Pomeranian on steroids.
His name is Quazito Truka. White werewolves are born for *slaughter*, and the strong ones are six-star monsters.
And Jin cannot carry Mesa and fight this thing at the same *time*.
Quazito offers a deal. Fight with *honor*, or run and get torn to pieces. Jin raises his sword.
The hammer comes down, and it gets *ugly*. This guy hits like a freight train.
Magic cannot pierce that hide, and the clan would sniff it out. That leaves one *option*. Awaken the sword.
Small problem. Days earlier, Murakhan warned him. Awaken that sword again and the overload could *kill* you. Moron.
Quazito grins. It's over, cub! He lifts the hammer for the *kill*.
Then Jin's eyes glow blue. *Awaken*. Full Super Saiyan mode.
Light explodes, and the werewolf screams that he cannot *see*.
One slash, and the great white werewolf drops in a spray of *blood*. Badass.
But Jin pays the *price*. Shadow force tears through his body, and a voice in his head calls him the *shame* of the clan.
Murakhan's warning rings in his ears. Get up, or the overload will *kill* you. Jin forces himself to breathe, and release it, again and *again*.
The pain fades. Then a crash. Someone is *there*.
A trembling young man begs for his life. He is Sember Bill, the missing *heir*, and Jin found him *alive*.
Mesa leans on Jin as he carries them both *out*.
Sember says he followed his lover into the forest. Problem is, she died two years *ago*. Yeah, that's a red flag.
The Kinzelo copied her face, her voice, even the *moles* on her wrist. That is the work of Bubarre, the Transfigurator.
Sember swears to remember this day for his whole *life*. Back home, Gilly *congratulates* Jin on his first mission.
But somebody in the dark has been waiting. A black cat with glowing eyes, and then a *chomp*.
Jin throws the cat across the room. Why the hell did you *bite* me? Because the idiot used his shadow *force*.
Murakhan noticed at once. Jin's shadow force jumped from three stars to *four*.
Only eleven people have ever lived through an overload. Jin is the eleventh. Nine of them died, and Murakhan is the other *survivor*.
Meanwhile his siblings whisper that Jin could never beat a white werewolf *alone*. Maybe a thug in a wolf mask did it.
The Tona twins listen and start *sweating*. The real problem is that Jin is joining the intermediate *class*.
Jin knows it. The moment he walks in, the twins and their crew will try to *sabotage* him.
Then his mother offers him the next patriarch's room. Jin says no. It is too *big* for him.
She smiles. It was a *test*, and he passed.
The next day, Jin walks into the intermediate class, where cadets are sorted into *factions*, and Elder Jed warns that everyone is on their own.
Then the twins' men try to *intimidate* the newcomers.
Kazine Romero, a burly cadet, sizes him up. But Jin walks straight at *him*.
Jin draws, and *cuts* him down.
The whole yard goes silent. Jin shrugs. Call the doctors. You are the ones who *need* them.
Kazine's men scream at him to draw his sword. Jin says he only slashed him for glaring with *murderous* intent.
Elder Jed lets it slide, because the war of ranks is an old Runcandel *tradition*. Kazine's crew look like total idiots.
Jin turns to the whole class and gives his name. *The thirteenth child.*
Then Jed's aura cracks the air. Do you think you can behave like this before *me*? Jin looks up. I believe I am fighting *you*, Elder Jed.
Jed stares him down. *Explain*. I will hear your answer before I decide to kill you *right here*.
